issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies a public method `calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int` in `SealSaloon`, but the solution implements the pricing method as `computeMealCost(Meal): int` instead. Students following the specification (and tests) will look for/implement `calculateTotalPrice`, while the reference solution and provided Main example use a different name.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename `computeMealCost(Meal)` to `calculateTotalPrice(Meal)` in `SealSaloon` (keeping the required static/non-static modifier consistent with the clarified spec) and update any call sites (e.g., `Main`).

issues.description: The problem statement contradicts itself about whether `SealSaloon.stock` is an instance field or a static shared field: it first says the saloon has a `final Stock stock` initialized in the constructor (implying per-instance), but later explicitly requires `stock` to be static and shared across all instances. This makes the required class design unclear.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the specification to choose one design: either (a) `private final Stock stock` as an instance field and make `acceptSupplyDelivery`/`calculateTotalPrice` non-static, or (b) explicitly require `private static final Stock stock` and remove wording implying per-instance ownership.

issues.description: The problem statement/UML for `Stock` does not include a `setStockIngredients(...)` method, but the template (and solution) provide this public setter. This extra method suggests an interface that is not part of the required design and can confuse students about what they are expected to implement/use.
issues.suggestedFix: Either remove `setStockIngredients(...)` from the starter code (and adjust `Main` accordingly) or explicitly document it as a non-UML helper intended only for manual setup/testing and not required for the exercise.
